drift.rule: report MAE vs unseen-circuit validation MAE; no threshold

h1.rule: pass if 95% CI lower bound >= threshold; fail if upper bound < threshold; else inconclusive

unseen_qpu.rule: chips without training data are predicted zero-shot by the pooled model and by each single-chip model; same H1 rule applied per scope; seen and unseen QPU results are reported separately and never pooled
